name: @ra/cluster-production
description: RAW AROMACHEM production cluster (production schema): CRUD + flow over production plan/order, material pick/issue, secure mixing, oil batch (master + consumption genealogy + event history), and production QC. Expands an APPROVED formula into a production order's bill-of-materials SERVER-SIDE via FORMULA_LOOKUP.getPickList (the floor never sees the formula). Emits production.order.created / production.materials.issued / production.oil_batch.created. Exposes PRODUCTION_LOOKUP.
